name: Editorial Forest
avoid_for: Contexts that need to feel urgent, punchy, or sales-driven — the palette and rhythm are intentionally quiet
weak_cases: Many small technical panels weaken the single-subject editorial rhythm; low-contrast fills need inspection.
visual_signature: Source Serif optical hierarchy, green/pink/oat paper and filled-versus-outlined tiles.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Serif optical sizing and mono labels require intentional script-specific substitutes, not synthetic equivalence.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
